title: Construct bounded central tensions on every declared downset prefix
statement: The actual row/column tail sums of alternating loads satisfy local force and torque balance and |Tx|<=|Fx|, |Ty|<=|Fy| independently of size/order. Uniform-drive tail tensions instead grow with remaining row/column length.

requires: Every prefix is the declared downset with axis seeds and designated predecessors
Ideal point centers, zero torque, quasistatic alternating force and central bonds with warranted capacities
assumptions: Not a compatible small-deformation elastic realization
No detachments/holes/fusions or arbitrary two-contact growth
costs: Joint loads, seed capacities, stiffness/shear/registration, support and coherent-bias budgets
contract.units: Force/tension in newtons; integer tile coordinates.
contract.obstruction: Whole-object zero load does not establish local joint capacity.

evidence.quote: 1. Net force cancellation alone is insufficient.
evidence.range_scope: Governing producer statement; retain the complete source contract and review scope.

body: Independent review is explicitly not yet performed. This is conditional statics, not stability or an acquired actuation/assembly operation. Net total force cancellation alone does not bound a separating joint. Designated input roles, rigid seed, capacities, shear response and exact counter-drive are actual obligations. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.

review.scope: Source explicitly says independent review not yet performed; no new review or replay is performed.
